name: gestão de confecção
install: cd /workspace && if [ -f package.json ]; then if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi; else echo '[install] No package.json at /workspace on this revision - skipping npm install'; fi
start: cd /workspace && if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo '[start] No package.json at /workspace - nothing to start'; elif [ ! -d node_modules ]; then if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi; fi && if [ -f package.json ]; then if curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health >/dev/null || curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health >/dev/null; then echo '[start] API already running'; elif node -e "process.exit(require('./package.json').scripts && require('./package.json').scripts.dev ? 0 : 1)"; then nohup npm run dev >/tmp/gestao-dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/gestao-dev.pid; ready=0; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 60 ]; do if curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health >/dev/null || curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health >/dev/null; then echo '[start] API is ready'; ready=1; break; fi; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done; if [ "$ready" != 1 ]; then echo '[start] Timed out waiting for API. See /tmp/gestao-dev.log' >&2; false; fi; else echo '[start] No npm dev script - skipping servers'; fi; fi
